svg.text: drawn by edakit schematic draw – change the graph, not this drawing
Plugged into two 1x15 female headers, powered through its USB socket
D2-D6: countdown LEDs, D8: servo, D11/D12: start/reset buttons
Symbol pins are ATmega ports; pins 14/15 are labelled PB4/PB3 – on the Nano they are D11 = PB3, D12 = PB4
Servo at the Nano's 5V pin; C1 buffers its start-up peaks
Nets with the same name are connected (labels and power flags).
Variant THT (D-12): through-hole parts only, no assembly – every part
LED1, LED4, LED5: the library symbols name A and K the other way round;
the anode is the pad with the + print (footprint), see hardware/parts.
R8 + R9: base load, keeps USB power banks on (D-8).
Drawn by edakit schematic draw – change the graph, not this sheet.
